scope: OctoSense on a Mac desktop: the shell's chrome and every app, light and dark, in a window at its default size. The existing acceptance rubric (acceptance-rubric.json) still governs Android and live-service sign-off; a physical phone is out of this rubric's scope and stays unverified here.
reference: A current Mac app of the same kind: Finder, Mail, Calendar, Photos, Maps, Preview, Keynote, Pages, System Settings, Notes, Reminders, Terminal, Numbers, Activity Monitor, Calculator, Clock, Weather, Safari.

anchors.0: Blocked task, or essential content unreadable; or it plainly reads as another platform
anchors.0.6: Completes with substantial friction; a phone or web layout on a desktop
anchors.0.8: Usable and Mac-like at a glance; visible deviations or a state not checked
anchors.0.9: Reads as a Mac app in every observed state; minor deviations remain
anchors.1: Indistinguishable in kind from the reference app in every specified state

hard_gates: No clipped or obscured essential text, editor or action at the default window size
No blank dead end: every empty state says what to do and offers the action
No developer text (command lines, ids, raw errors) in normal use
A required state that was not looked at caps its dimensions at 0.8 and prevents a final pass
Script errors or panics in the run's log fail the app

criteria: Navigation is a sidebar, toolbar or inspector, not a phone tab bar or stacked pages
The window's first screen shows the app's content, with no hero header
Actions live where a Mac app puts them: the toolbar, a row's trailing edge, a sheet
Push buttons, tools, fields and segmented controls at Mac metrics: about 28 points tall, radius about 6, no pills or 44-point targets
One default action in the accent colour at most per surface
Hover, pressed, selected and disabled states read as a Mac's
Body text about 13 points, secondary 11 to 12, titles from 15 to 22; hierarchy by weight rather than size
Dense rows with even rhythm; no oversized display type in working screens
Window titles are the app's real name
Neutral surfaces with the system blue accent; a page, a sidebar and a toolbar a shade apart, hairline separators
Everything follows light and dark, including content and sheets
Text contrast at least 4.5:1
One obvious next action in empty and populated states
Related actions next to their content
No dead-end controls
Nothing clipped or overlapping at the default size, in light and dark
A narrower window keeps its essential actions
Scroll areas and columns end where they should
The app's journeys pass: editing, saving, restart, retained input across an appearance switch
The phone tree is unchanged: its journeys pass in a phone-sized preview
The shared interface and glyph family, not a look of its own
Same selection, spacing and toolbar conventions as the other apps

out of scope.rinx: Owned by another session; reviewed only, not changed.
out of scope.wasmlab: In the Wasm Lab build only (desktop/system-apps-wasm-lab.json), not in the shipped app list. It takes the Mac metrics from the shared interface but is not graded.
out of scope.appcard: Opt-in developer runtime (apps/appcard), not in the shipped app list.
